# Module 8 — interfaces

Allowed: modules 1–7, plus interfaces, `implements`, default methods, and static interface methods.

Do not suggest or require: nested classes, inner classes, anonymous classes, collections, regular expressions, exceptions, `try`, `catch`, `throw`, lambda expressions, method references, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not ask to replace an interface implementation with a lambda.
